newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Satair to float on Copenhagen bourse.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Satair to float on Copenhagen bourse.

text.p: Danish aviation spares distributor Satair said on Wednesday that it would list its shares on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange from June 3.
A Satair statement said that 622,200 shares of a nominal 20 crowns each -- totalling 31 percent of capital -- would be offered by tender at a minimum rate of 140 crowns each from May 28-30 inclusive.

It said that Satair, with 1995/1996 turnover of $35.9 million, was one of the world's largest distributors of aircraft parts, supplying over 1,000 clients worldwide, including British Airways, SAS, Lufthansa, Air France and carriers in the United States and Asia.
First half 1996/1997 net profits were 13 million Danish crowns.
